pec.title: PEC mailbox
pec.tradeoff: One password opens the whole mailbox: it can read every PEC (including official notices) and send PEC as you. Use a unique generated mail-client password only for this app, keep a second factor on your Cloudflare and GitHub accounts, and rotate it after any suspicion. Each send also needs your passkey or an authenticator code.
pec.serversHint: Aruba defaults are filled in. Change them only if your provider differs. Saving clears the last connection test.
pec.serversSaved: Servers saved. Run the connection test again.
pec.serversInvalid: These servers are not valid. Check the host names and ports.
pec.testScope: Logs in to IMAP, opens the inbox read-only, reads the quota if the server has it, and logs in to SMTP. Nothing is read from messages and nothing is sent.

finalize.title: Finalize invoice
finalize.reviewPec: The invoice is checked first: complete client, a VAT rate or exemption on every line, totals, number rules, the invoice file against the official XSD schema and your setup for sending. If it is valid, it is numbered, finalised and sent to the SdI through your PEC, and it can no longer be edited. If something is wrong, you see what to fix and nothing else happens.
finalize.reviewManual: The invoice is checked first: complete client, a VAT rate or exemption on every line, totals, number rules and the invoice file against the official XSD schema. If it is valid, it is numbered and finalised, and the XML is stored for you to upload on the AdE portal: nothing is sent by the app, because the PEC is not ready. If something is wrong, you see what to fix and nothing else happens.
finalize.confirmNote: Your passkey (or code) is checked by the server for this exact invoice file before anything is sent.
finalize.manualNote: After this, download the XML from the invoice page, upload it on the AdE portal and confirm there.
finalize.problems: The invoice cannot be finalised yet. Fix these points; nothing was numbered or sent:
finalize.manualInstead: Finalize will prepare the invoice for the AdE portal instead of sending it by PEC.

errors.invalid_xml: The invoice file is not valid yet. Fix these points and send again:
errors.numberReleased: The reserved number was given back; nothing was sent.
errors.numberKept: The number stays reserved for this invoice (it cannot be given back); fix the points and send again.
errors.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was sent. The invoice keeps its reserved number until you send it.
errors.build_failed: The invoice file could not be prepared. Try again.
errors.missing_data: The client or the company details are missing.
errors.send_not_authorized: Your passkey or code was not accepted for this invoice file. Nothing was sent; try again.
errors.pec_auth_failed: The PEC server refused the login. Aruba needs the dedicated mail-client password: set it again with wrangler secret put PEC_PASSWORD and run the connection test. Nothing was sent.
errors.pec_mailbox_full: The PEC mailbox is full. Free some space in the Aruba webmail and send again. Nothing was sent.
errors.pec_sdi_address_missing: The SdI address was not accepted. Check the PEC setup. Nothing was sent.
errors.pec_unavailable: The PEC server could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes, or use the manual AdE channel. Nothing was sent.
errors.pec_rejected: The PEC server refused the message. Nothing was sent; try again or use the manual AdE channel.
errors.send_outcome_unknown: The connection broke while sending, so the message may have reached the SdI.
errors.unknownNote: Do not send it again yet: the mailbox is checked automatically. If nothing shows up, you can resend 15 minutes after the attempt.
errors.conflict: This invoice cannot be sent in its current state. Reload the page.
errors.number_unavailable: The invoice number is no longer free. Nothing was reserved or sent: check the Number field and send again.

detail.waitingReceipt: Handed to the PEC server. Waiting for the delivery receipt from the SdI mailbox.
detail.unknown: The send was interrupted and its outcome is unknown. The mailbox is checked automatically for the sent message and its receipts; do not send it again yet.
detail.retryAt: If nothing shows up, you can resend after {{when}}.
detail.awaitingPoll: The waiting time is over. The mailbox is checked once more within about 10 minutes; if the message is still not there, you can then resend.
detail.resendNew: Resend with a new file name
detail.manualHandedOver: I uploaded it on the AdE portal
detail.manualHint: Manual channel: download the XML (and PDF), upload it on the Agenzia delle Entrate portal, then tell the app. No PEC is sent.
detail.waitingSdi: Delivered to the SdI mailbox. Waiting for the SdI outcome (delivered, not delivered or rejected).
detail.manualWaiting: Uploaded to the AdE portal by hand. Set the outcome shown there.
detail.fixAndResend: The SdI rejected this invoice. Fix the points shown next to the fields, then use Fix & resend: same number and date, new file name.
